headline: Up Your Arsenal gains native NTSC-U frontend routines
summary: Six native NTSC-U routines landed across eight program placements, covering frontend state, timers, fades and callbacks (#1). The progress commit reports NTSC-U at 5,677 of 16,222 functions and 8.38% matched code. The project's separate PAL v1.00 report stands at 5,807 of 16,164 functions and 657,780 of 7,546,948 code bytes, or 8.72% by size.
highlights: Matching means a function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. These frontend reconstructions do not establish that the game is playable.
